blueprints.description: 【黑川茜 · 试镜间】试镜间的白墙前，黑川茜收起所有犹豫，一瞬间进入角色，蓝紫瞳孔里的星芒若隐若现——「角色活在剧本里……而演员，是把她们请进现实的人。」
blueprints.action: 白墙前入戏试镜
blueprints.camera: medium shot, holding script
blueprints.promptProse: Captivating casting directors under bright audition lights, Akane channels star-filled eyes with breathtaking acting intensity. Crisp directional spotlights emphasize her magnetic, transformative stage presence.

blueprints.title: 黑川茜 · 咖啡店对谈
blueprints.description: 【黑川茜 · 咖啡店对谈】欧式复古咖啡厅高大拱形落地窗旁，黑川茜侧身端坐于皮椅上品尝咖啡，明媚逆光在发丝与宝蓝长裙勾勒出唯美轮廓光，双目闪烁着标志性的耀眼星瞳——「演戏是假装别人……和你说话的时候，我才是我自己。」

blueprints.title: 有马加奈 · B小町舞台的定格

blueprints.promptProse: At the center of a concert stage, Kana grips her microphone and lands the final pose of a song. A bead of sweat shines at her temple beneath wine-red bangs, while her red-and-white layered costume catches a single brilliant spotlight. Her ruby eyes burn with practiced concentration; the medium stage portrait gives the frame to her alone, with dark theatrical space behind the light.

blueprints.title: 有马加奈 · 排练室镜子前的独白

blueprints.promptProse: After repeating a turn in the empty rehearsal studio, Kana sits on the floor beside taped position marks and drinks from a water bottle. Her red bob rests against the charcoal T-shirt as she studies her reflection in the wall mirror. Frustration and self-encouragement share her expression; broad studio lighting shows the practice shoes, floor tape and unglamorous work behind the performance.

blueprints.title: 有马加奈 · 剧本围读的荧光笔
blueprints.description: 事务所会议室，她面前摊着画满荧光笔与便签的剧本，手指抵着下巴默读台词；周围人还没进入状态，她已经完全沉浸在角色里——努力家的素颜。
blueprints.action: 手指抵着下巴默读剧本，帽子放在荧光笔与便签旁。
blueprints.camera: medium shot, environmental portrait
blueprints.promptProse: Before the others arrive at the agency meeting room, Kana silently studies a script crowded with highlighter marks and small page flags. A fingertip rests beneath her chin, ruby eyes following the next line. Her beret sits beside the notebook rather than on her head; a cream cardigan and soft overhead light frame this absorbed table portrait, with the marked pages clearly present but unreadable.

blueprints.title: 有马加奈 · 10 秒落泪的现场
blueprints.description: 拍摄现场，导演喊开始后她低头调整呼吸，再抬头时眼泪已经精准挂在眼眶里；画面捕捉情绪到位的一瞬间，是她职业能力的最高光。
blueprints.action: 调整一次呼吸后抬头，将泪水准确凝在眼眶里。
blueprints.camera: medium shot, environmental portrait
blueprints.promptProse: A single continuous close view of Kana Arima on a film set, cropped from the shoulders upward. Her head has just lifted after a steady breath; one tear gathers on the lower rim of each ruby eye, her mouth closed in controlled sadness. Wine-red blunt bangs and the white collar of her school blouse remain visible. A softly blurred studio lamp glows behind her left shoulder. Only one face appears, filling most of the unbroken canvas.

blueprints.title: 有马加奈 · 贝雷帽店的挑选
blueprints.description: 帽饰店，她踮着脚取下货架上不同颜色的贝雷帽在镜前比对，表情是面对专业装备般的严肃；「帽皇」的人设在这一幕以生活化方式落地。
blueprints.action: 踮脚取下贝雷帽，认真对比不同颜色。
blueprints.camera: medium shot, environmental portrait
blueprints.promptProse: Inside a hat shop, Kana rises on her toes to lift a beret from a high shelf, comparing its color against another held near the mirror. Her expression is as serious as if choosing professional equipment. A cream cardigan sleeve stretches with the raised arm; warm shop lighting separates red, blue and ivory hats around her focused reflection in a three-quarter portrait.

blueprints.title: 有马加奈 · 祭典捞金鱼的胜负欲
blueprints.description: 夏祭摊位，她挽起袖子全神贯注捞金鱼，浴衣袖摆滑下也顾不上；捞到之后高高举起战利品，虎牙都笑出来的瞬间，比舞台笑容更真实。
blueprints.action: 举起装着金鱼的小袋开怀大笑，另一手仍拿着纸网。

blueprints.promptProse: Kana lifts a small goldfish bag triumphantly above the festival pool, laughing so openly that her tiny canine tooth shows. Her red-and-white yukata sleeves are gathered safely clear of the water, one hand still holding the paper scoop. Warm lantern light ripples over the pool and her delighted ruby eyes in a close, lively portrait of winning an ordinary summer game.

blueprints.title: 有马加奈 · 演出现场休息室的主控跨坐 ·「阿库亚……你今晚的推子只能是我！」
